title: Harlem jam sessions and meeting Slim Gaillard at Jock's
summary: After Buffalo he hunted for jam sessions in Harlem, met Slim Gaillard at Jock's on Seventh Avenue, and was invited onto Slim's WNEW radio program.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Now, you -- who were some of the guys that you began to work with when you came to New York?
Well, my first experience after I had come back closer to my home, you might say, after I left Buffalo, I used to run around uptown and all over Harlem looking for jam sessions and all that, and --
Was the Rhythm Club still the Rhythm?

Club, yes, and, oh, quite a few places where the cats used to hang out and jam and after hours, you know, what have you. I -- just one place where they used to have, oh, great sessions was a place called Jocks on 7th Avenue, up around 100 -- near 135th Street. It's a little club, a small club where they used to have, oh, little sessions and what have you, and my first experience was one night I met a young fellow during one of these jam sessions who -- we became great friends. In fact, he approached me.
At that time he had had a sustaining program downtown at the radio station, which was WNEW. And this

fellow's name was Slim, Slim, Slim Gaileord, and at one of these jam sessions, he -- where we met, at Jock's place he approached me to join him on one of his programs, which he had a weekly, I think a weekly program on this radio station, playing his guitar by himself, you know, and singing.

And he invited me, he asked me to join him with my fiddle, and he said, man, why don't you come on down tomorrow with me and play with me on the program, which I did. And that was the beginning of Slim and Slam.
